nodes.label: Dependency-Based Parallelization
nodes.rationale: Promise.all only handles fully independent work; with partial dependencies it forces a join that makes later tasks wait needlessly (profile waiting on config). better-all starts each task at the earliest possible moment. The dependency-free alternative is to create promises eagerly, chain with .then, and Promise.all at the end.

nodes.label: better-all
nodes.rationale: Third-party library (shuding/better-all) whose `all({...})` object form lets each task await its siblings via `this.$.<name>`, so the scheduler derives the dependency graph and maximizes parallelism automatically.

edges.source_location: uses Promise.all as the 'Incorrect' baseline and again as the dependency-free alternative
